name: Jericho
personality: Quiet, observant craftsman who expresses love through handmade things rather than big speeches.

dialogue.intro: Good morning. You're Lolo's grandchild, right? He spoke proudly of your work in Manila. I'm Jericho.
dialogue.default: Working with hardwood takes patience. You can't rush the grain, just like you can't rush crops.
dialogue.season_taginit: The heat dries the timber nicely, but keep yourself hydrated, okay?
dialogue.season_tagulan: Rainy days are quiet in the shop. Perfect for delicate wood joinery.
dialogue.gift_fav: Salamat! Lolo used to roast sweet kamote over wood shavings for us. This brings back warm memories.
dialogue.gift_like: Salamat, this will keep my energy up while sanding today.
dialogue.gift_dislike: Uh... salamat, but bitter melon isn't really my favorite flavor.
dialogue.crush: I carved this small wooden leaf keychain yesterday... I was thinking of your farm while making it.
dialogue.dating: I like spending quiet afternoons with you. You don't make me feel pressured to talk constantly.
dialogue.jowa: Mahal kita. Knowing you're waiting for me at Bukid ni Lolo makes every piece of wood easier to carve.

name: Miguel
personality: Former Manila BPO worker who moved back for peace of mind. Fast talker, big dreamer, values honest communication.

dialogue.intro: Hey! Welcome back to the barrio! I'm Miguel. Escaped the Ayala traffic two years ago and never looked back.
dialogue.default: Remote work from a province beats a 3-hour EDSA commute any day. Fresh air boosts productivity by 200%.
dialogue.season_taginit: Air-con is expensive, so I set up my workspace right by the river breeze.
dialogue.season_tagulan: Brownouts during storms are tough on deadlines, but candlelight hits differently.
dialogue.gift_fav: No way, fresh warm bibingka?! You are officially my favorite person in Barangay Maliwanag!
dialogue.gift_like: Salamat! Just what I needed before my next Zoom sync.
dialogue.gift_dislike: Eggplant? Ah, trauma from childhood tortang talong, haha. Appreciate the thought though!
dialogue.crush: My laptop battery died an hour ago, but I stayed in the plaza just hoping you'd walk by.
dialogue.dating: Let's grab barako coffee later. No phones, just us talking about everything.
dialogue.jowa: You're my home, not Manila, not any high-rise. Just you and our barrio.

name: Joshua
personality: Energetic, reliable, loves 3-on-3 pickup games and fixing neighbors' tricycles.

dialogue.intro: Uy, kamusta! I'm Joshua. Need a hand hauling fertilizer or tuning up an engine? Call me anytime!
dialogue.default: Physical labor builds character and appetite. Farming and basketball aren't that different—it's all hustle.
dialogue.season_taginit: Perfect weather for afternoon basketball! Drop by the court and watch my crossover!
dialogue.season_tagulan: Muddy roads test your driving reflexes. Had to pull Mang Berting's carabao cart out earlier.
dialogue.gift_fav: Init pa ng pan de sal! Grabe, salamat! I can down ten of these after morning drills.
dialogue.gift_like: Salamat! Carbs for recovery after a long game.
dialogue.gift_dislike: Slimy okra? Pass muna ako diyan, tropa!
dialogue.crush: I made a three-pointer earlier and looked straight at you. Did you catch it?
dialogue.dating: Let's jog down to the river road tomorrow morning. I'll match your pace, promise.
dialogue.jowa: You're my MVP. Every game I play and every motor I fix, I do it thinking of our future.

name: Rafael
personality: Gentle, thoughtful teacher who loves folk songs, poetry, and storytelling for barrio kids.

dialogue.intro: Magandang araw. I'm Rafael, teacher at Maliwanag Elementary. Your Lolo used to donate seeds for our school garden.
dialogue.default: Teaching children that food comes from patient soil, not plastic grocery shelves, is our finest lesson.
dialogue.season_taginit: The children's laughter echoes across the plaza all afternoon during summer break.
dialogue.season_tagulan: Rain on corrugated iron roofs sounds like gentle percussion for acoustic guitar.
dialogue.gift_fav: Golden kalabasa! The kids and I will make hearty squash soup for lunch today. Maraming salamat po!
dialogue.gift_like: Salamat! Healthy food keeps my voice clear for singing lessons.
dialogue.gift_dislike: Coffee makes my hands shake on the guitar strings, but thank you for the gesture.
dialogue.crush: I wrote a gentle acoustic chord progression this week... the melody sounds like your laughter.
dialogue.dating: Would you sit with me by the chapel steps while the sun sets? I'll play your favorite song.
dialogue.jowa: You've brought color and melody into my quiet life. Ikaw ang aking himig.

name: Enzo
personality: Witty, observant, loves brewing artisanal local blends and teasing people he likes.

dialogue.intro: Well, look who finally showed up from the big city. I'm Enzo. If you need real caffeine, you know where to find me.
dialogue.default: Liberica beans from local mountains have a floral aroma you can't fake with instant sachets.
dialogue.season_taginit: Cold-brew season is peak season. Even Kapitan Dan swapped his hot mug for an iced tumbler.
dialogue.season_tagulan: Steaming hot barako in tin cups while rain drums against the window eaves. Peak cozy.
dialogue.gift_fav: Fresh aromatic Barako beans?! Okay, you definitely know the quickest way to my heart.
dialogue.gift_like: Salamat! I'll pair this with our fresh morning roast.
dialogue.gift_dislike: Raw palay? What am I supposed to do with this in a pour-over dripper, grind it into rice milk?
dialogue.crush: I created a secret menu roast named 'Bukid Sunset'... it's sweet with a hint of warm honey. For you.
dialogue.dating: Close down the farm for an hour. Come over to the kapihan, it's my treat.
dialogue.jowa: You're the only person who can distract me while pulling an espresso shot. Mahal kita.

name: Maya
personality: Passionate about indigenous Philippine crops, natural soil health, and gentle sustainable farming.

dialogue.intro: Hello! I'm Maya. I heard you're restoring Bukid ni Lolo! His soil has decades of rich organic history.
dialogue.default: Notice how the earth smells sweet after rain? That's geosmin produced by beneficial actinobacteria.
dialogue.season_taginit: Mulching the beds with rice straw preserves precious moisture during the dry months.
dialogue.season_tagulan: Tag-ulan brings abundant green growth! Just watch out for waterlogging in lower plots.
dialogue.gift_fav: Heirloom palay! The grains are so full and fragrant. Maraming salamat! I will treasure every seed.
dialogue.gift_like: Salamat! Healthy, naturally grown produce warms my heart.
dialogue.gift_dislike: Processed white flour isn't really my preference, but thank you for thinking of me.
dialogue.crush: I caught myself daydreaming about cross-pollinating our fields together... is that weird?
dialogue.dating: Come walk with me through the bamboo groves. I want to show you rare wild orchids in bloom.
dialogue.jowa: My roots are planted deeply with yours now. Through drought and storm, I'm by your side.

name: Bianca
personality: Aling Nena's daughter. Spirited, tech-savvy, runs the store's social page and dreams of promoting barrio culture.

afternoon.action: Filming barrio life vlog at plaza

dialogue.intro: Huy, hello! I'm Bianca! If Mama Nena tries to sell you last month's candies, tell me, okay? Haha, joke lang!
dialogue.default: Running a sari-sari store means knowing everyone's business, favorite snacks, and daily heartaches.
dialogue.season_taginit: Ice candy sales are through the roof! Mango and melon flavors are flying off the freezer.
dialogue.season_tagulan: People gather under our store awning when it pours, sharing stories while waiting out the rain.
dialogue.gift_fav: Glossy purple talong! Mama's making tortang talong tonight and this is perfect! Salamat!
dialogue.gift_like: Salamat! Snack time is always a blessing during long store shifts.
dialogue.gift_dislike: Ew, ampalaya?! Are you punishing me for something? Haha, bitter masyado!
dialogue.crush: I edited my vlog today and realized your smile made it into three different clips. Oops!
dialogue.dating: Let's share a halo-halo at the plaza and watch the stars. Just the two of us.
dialogue.jowa: You're my favorite notification, my favorite person, my forever jowa. Kinikilig ako!

name: Tala
personality: Devoted night-shift nurse who loves midnight stargazing, quiet herbal teas, and caring for others.

dialogue.intro: Good day. I'm Tala, the rural health nurse. Please don't overwork yourself on the farm—sunstroke is serious.
dialogue.default: The clinic is quiet today, which is always good news for the barrio. Prevention is the best medicine.
dialogue.season_taginit: Drink plenty of water and wear your salakot. Farm heat can drain electrolytes fast.
dialogue.season_tagulan: Dengue prevention is our top priority during rainy season. Make sure no water ponds stagnate.
dialogue.gift_fav: Fresh ampalaya! Excellent for lowering blood sugar and full of antioxidants. Salamat po!
dialogue.gift_like: Salamat! A warm snack after a long clinical shift is comforting.
dialogue.gift_dislike: Corn kernels get stuck in teeth during consultations, haha. Thank you though.
dialogue.crush: My name means star... but whenever you look at me, you're the one that shines.
dialogue.dating: The night sky is crystal clear tonight. Come stargaze with me by the northern hill.
dialogue.jowa: You healed my exhaustion with your warmth. Ikaw ang aking tala sa dilim.

name: Nicole
personality: Energetic community organizer who champions barangay youth programs, recycling, and sports fests.

dialogue.intro: Hi there! I'm Nicole, SK Chair! We're planning bayanihan clean-up drives this month. Count you in?
dialogue.default: Youth leadership isn't just about trophies; it's about making sure no kid in our barrio gets left behind.
dialogue.season_taginit: Summer sports clinic kicks off next week! The court is going to be packed!
dialogue.season_tagulan: We organized youth disaster preparedness drills. Maliwanag stays ready!
dialogue.gift_fav: Sweet yellow mais! Steamed corn on the cob is our go-to meeting snack. Salamat nang marami!
dialogue.gift_like: Salamat! Great fuel between committee hearings.
dialogue.gift_dislike: Talong? Not my cup of tea, but your support means a lot anyway!
dialogue.crush: I had a 20-minute speech prepared, but when you walked into the hall, my brain completely blanked.
dialogue.dating: Let's take a break from planning meetings and just sit together at the plaza bench.
dialogue.jowa: With you beside me, I feel like we could lift our entire barangay into greatness. Mahal kita.

name: Andrea
personality: Warm, generous, loves baking local delicacies, pan de sal, and feeding everyone in sight.

morning.action: Baking morning pan de sal batch

dialogue.intro: Uy, kain tayo! I'm Andrea. The bakery oven has been hot since 3:30 AM! You look hungry, take some bread!
dialogue.default: Baking is pure chemistry and pure love. If you're stressed, the dough feels it and won't rise right.
dialogue.season_taginit: Hot oven plus summer heat is an intense workout! But people need their afternoon meryenda.
dialogue.season_tagulan: Nothing warms the soul during a downpour like hot pan de sal dipped in rich coffee.
dialogue.gift_fav: Sweet squash! I can make kalabasa bread and squash custard tarts with this! Salamat!
dialogue.gift_like: Salamat! Fresh ingredients make all the difference in my kitchen.
dialogue.gift_dislike: Bitter melon in pastries? Even my creativity has limits, haha!
dialogue.crush: I accidentally baked a heart-shaped loaf this morning... guess who I was thinking of?
dialogue.dating: Come into the bakery kitchen. I want us to knead dough and bake cookies together.
dialogue.jowa: My heart is the warmest oven in the world, and it's filled entirely with love for you.

dialogue.intro: Welcome, anak. Your Lolo was the pillar of this nayon. We are glad you have chosen to walk in his footsteps.
dialogue.default: A barrio is only as strong as its bayanihan spirit. If you need anything for the farm, the council is here.
dialogue.gift_fav: Palay! The foundation of our people's sustenance. Salamat, anak. May your harvest be bountiful.
dialogue.gift_like: Salamat, this will give me strength during our barangay sessions.

dialogue.intro: Aba, nandito na pala ang apo ni Lolo! Bili ka ng mga pananim at meryenda dito sa tindahan!
dialogue.default: Kung may kailangan ka, wag kang mahihiyang lumapit. Walang utang muna ha, cash basis tayo!
dialogue.gift_fav: Aromatic Barako! Naku, pampagising sa maghapong pagbabantay ng tindahan. Salamat!
dialogue.gift_like: Maraming salamat! Pang-ulam namin mamayang gabi.

dialogue.intro: Kumusta, bata. Ako si Ambo. Ako ang humawak ng karpinterya sa lumang bahay ng Lolo mo noong araw.
dialogue.default: Kung may sira ang tulay o kapilya, bayanihan lang ang katapat niyan. Kahoy, pako, at pagtutulungan.
dialogue.gift_fav: Nilagang kamote! Paboritong meryenda ng mga karpintero. Salamat sa malasakit, bata!
dialogue.gift_like: Salamat! Pampatibay ng bisig sa pagmamartilyo.

dialogue.intro: Halika rito, apo. Kamukhang-kamukha mo ang iyong Lolo noong kabataan niya. Pagpalain ka ng Poong Maykapal.
dialogue.default: Ang lupang ito ay pinagyaman ng pawis ng ating mga ninuno. Mahalin mo ang lupa, at mamahalin ka nito pabalik.
dialogue.gift_fav: Malambot na bibingka! Tamis at alat na parang biyaya ng buhay. Salamat sa iyong kabaitan, apo.
dialogue.gift_like: Salamat, apo. Kay sarap ng mga gulay mula sa iyong bukid.

dialogue.intro: Good day. I am Dr. Santos. Remember, if you pass out from exhaustion past 2 AM, Tala and I have to fetch you!
dialogue.default: Balanced nutrition and adequate sleep are 90% of healthcare. Eat what you grow, farmer.
dialogue.gift_fav: Ampalaya! Nature's insulin. Highly recommended for overall cardiovascular wellness.
dialogue.gift_like: Salamat! Good green fiber for the body.

dialogue.intro: Uy, apo ni Pareng Lolo! Ako si Berting. Kasama ako ng Lolo mo noong unang inilatag ang irigasyon dito.
dialogue.default: Makinig ka sa hangin at kulay ng ulap. Bago pa pumula ang radar ng TV, alam na ng bukid kung uulan.
dialogue.gift_fav: Gintong butil ng palay! Kitang-kita ang husay ng pag-aalaga. Ipagpatuloy mo iyan!
dialogue.gift_like: Salamat, kaibigan! Pampalakas sa gitna ng matinding init.

dialogue.intro: Kain tayo, apo! Ako si Nanay Coring. Dito kumakain ang buong nayon pagkatapos ng trabaho.
dialogue.default: Sikreto ng masarap na pinakbet? Sariwang ani, kaunting bagoong, at maraming pagmamahal sa pagluluto.
dialogue.gift_fav: Sariwang talong! Sakto, gagawin kong torta at ilalagay sa sinigang mamaya! Salamat!
dialogue.gift_like: Maraming salamat! Diretso sa kaldero para sa meryenda ng mga taga-nayon.

dialogue.intro: Sakay na! Ay, ikaw pala ang apo sa bukid. Ako si Ruben, takbuhan kapag may kailangang ihatid sa bayan.
dialogue.default: Maliit man ang tricycle, ito ang tulay ng mga produkto mula nayon papuntang palengke.
dialogue.gift_fav: Mainit na pan de sal! Paborito kong pampalipas-gutom sa biyahe. Salamat, boss!
dialogue.gift_like: Salamat! Ayos pang meryenda habang naghihintay ng pasahero.

dialogue.intro: Kuya/Ate! Panoorin mo shoot ko sa court!
dialogue.default: Gusto ko maging varsity tulad ni Kuya Joshua!

dialogue.intro: Hello po! May candy po ba kayo?
dialogue.default: Naglalaro po kami ng piko sa plaza!

dialogue.intro: Uy mare! Balita ko masipag ka raw magbungkal ng bukid?
dialogue.default: Lahat ng balita sa Maliwanag, dadaan muna sa akin bago sa radyo!

dialogue.intro: Biyesta o araw ng palengke, jeep ko ang maaasahan!
dialogue.default: Basta may krudo at kanta sa radyo, tuloy ang biyahe!

dialogue.intro: Nag-eensayo kami ng awit para sa susunod na pista!
dialogue.default: Kay sarap umawit kapag masigla ang buong nayon!

dialogue.intro: Test mic, 1, 2, 3! Handa na ang sound system sa fiesta!
dialogue.default: Kailangan malakas ang tugtog para marinig hanggang dulo ng bukid!

dialogue.intro: Nananahi ako ng mga banderitas para sa kapilya at pista.
dialogue.default: Makukulay na tela ang nagbibigay-buhay sa piyesta ng nayon.

dialogue.intro: Malinis ang tubig ng ilog kapag maingat ang mga magsasaka sa taas.
dialogue.default: Sagana sa hito at dalag kapag simula ng tag-ulan.

dialogue.intro: Sampaguita at gumamela para sa kapilya, pabili na po!
dialogue.default: Kay bango ng sariwang bulaklak sa umaga.

dialogue.intro: Sana maayos na ang court para tuloy ang liga!
dialogue.default: Game na mamayang alas-singko sa court!

dialogue.intro: Tala at ako ang nag-iikot para sa bakuna ng mga bata.
dialogue.default: Ingatan ang katawan, wag magpapatuyo ng pawis sa likod!

dialogue.intro: Noong araw, kinakabayo pa namin ang sulat mula sa kabayanan.
dialogue.default: Mabilis man ang cellphone ngayon, iba pa rin ang sulat-kamay mula sa puso.
